caption: The drawing features a single female figure standing in the center of a vertically oriented rectangular panel. She is depicted in a long, flowing gown with draped, layered fabric, and a veil or scarf covering her head and extending behind her. Her hands are clasped at her waist, and her expression and posture are both downward facing. The figure is placed amidst a rocky environment with jagged formations at her feet and sides. In the upper part of the drawing, a tree branch with leaves and two round fruits or flowers extends horizontally. The lower portion of the image shows additional rocky terrain with a small branch bearing leaves and flowers, and there are dark shadows surrounding her feet. The entire composition is executed in grayscale, with varying shades of gray, white, and black employed to create depth, highlights, and shadows. The background behind the figure consists of arched, swirling shapes, possibly indicating a cave or underground setting. The drawing is bordered by a thin, dark rectangular frame, and the surrounding area outside the central panel is left blank with a plain, light-colored background.
